# Independent DOCX compatibility fixtures

These files are unchanged copies from the official Mammoth.js and python-docx repositories at the commits linked in sources.json. Each file is identified by SHA-256 and its applicable upstream license. They are test data, not application runtime assets. No upstream code is executed.

The Application field is read from document metadata. It does not prove authorship or constitute a local Microsoft Word/WPS verification.

The tests require successful semantic round trips for 11 fixtures and explicit rejection of 7 unsupported fixtures. See ../../../docs/m7-docx-compatibility.md for scope and results.
